message:
Danielle Cathleen the Maryland Public Service Commission can be found by typing in the above name on any search engine that you use, google,yahoo are whichever is your choice. On their site they will have an area for consumer complaints. transportation and  utilities. Be sure and have your Verizon bill available because you will have to give your account number. Tell them that you did contact the company and what happened, especially the part about asking for your social security number. (in my case they asked for the last four of mine and I still refused.)

They PVP(payment verification point) is the dollar amount that they have assigned to you.(again you will not know anything about this until you file a complaint against them and you will know of it for the first time when they respond back to you through the commission). Allow them to mention it to you first in their response. Do not put that in your complaint.

The Maryland Department of Budget and Management is the agency that does the contract for the Department of Corrections inmate telephone. I forget to mention that Ellis Kitchen telephone # is 410-260-7041 please call him and let him know what is going on.
